hooks.command: bash -c 'cd backend && python3 -m pip install -q -r requirements.txt 2>/dev/null && echo "backend deps ok" || echo "backend pip install skipped (no venv?)"'
bash -c 'test -d rider-app/node_modules && echo "rider-app deps ok" || (cd rider-app && yarn install --frozen-lockfile --silent && echo "rider-app deps installed")'
bash -c 'test -d driver-app/node_modules && echo "driver-app deps ok" || (cd driver-app && yarn install --frozen-lockfile --silent && echo "driver-app deps installed")'
bash -c 'test -d admin-dashboard/node_modules && echo "admin deps ok" || (cd admin-dashboard && npm ci --silent && echo "admin deps installed")'
